game.title: SHAPE-O-CHET ENDLESS
game.description:
SHAPE-O-CHET ENDLESS is a physics traversal prototype in which you draw temporary lines to guide a bouncing shape upward. The track curves, lava rises from below and contact with an ordinary floor or wall ends the run. Your drawn lines provide the safe surfaces needed to thread each opening.

Drawing pauses the shape while you aim, but the lava keeps moving. Ink drops, pause-time clocks and lava-push pickups support longer attempts, while stages become harder every ten floors. game.tips: Lava continues rising even while movement is paused, so keep planning breaks short. Draw a line toward the next opening instead of letting the shape touch a floor. Different shape geometries change the bounce, and the temporary lines last only about three seconds.
